# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or logp_with_result.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_with_result must be a 2D numpy array")
    if not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or logp_call_only.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_call_only must be a 2D numpy array")
    if not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray) or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_no_call must be a 2D numpy array")
    if logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0:
        raise ValueError("empty matrix")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("shape mismatch")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite values")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("positive values")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("invalid threshold")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("threshold must be nonnegative finite")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if sum_raw == 0:
        raise ValueError("all weights zero")
    weights = raw_weights / sum_raw

    # Compute losses
    loss_with = np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_nocall = np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margin: min improvement over no-call and call-only
    margin = np.minimum(loss_nocall - loss_with, loss_call - loss_with)

    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
